notes: OfferCard.tsx (props { dto: OrderDetailDto, expiresAt: string, onDismiss: () => void }) is the map-overlay TOP CARD replacing OfferTakeover's full-screen dialog. Rendered as `styled.section role="region" aria-label={t('driver.offer.boxLabel')}` ("Nová objednávka") — NOT role='dialog'/aria-modal; position:absolute top:0 anchored within the (WI-5) content region with env(safe-area-inset-top), z-index theme.zIndex.overlay, theme tokens only. Composes the existing pieces UNCHANGED: CountdownRing (totalSeconds computed once on mount via useRef = max(1, round((new Date(expiresAt)-Date.now())/1000)), onExpired -> setPhase('expired') + onDismiss after 2000ms), PriceBadge, useOfferRoute(dto.pickupLat,dto.pickupLng) rendered via the combined t('driver.offer.distanceEta',{km,min}) key (gated on both distanceMeters!=null && durationSeconds!=null since useOfferRoute returns them as a coupled pair), DeclineReasons in the declining phase, useOfferSound(phase==='offer') unchanged. LOAD-BEARING BEHAVIOR CHANGE (pinned by test 'on Accept success calls accept + onDismiss and NEVER navigates'): OfferCard does NOT import or call useNavigate at all — on accept success it calls onDismiss() ONLY. OfferTakeover previously did navigate('/driver/ride'); the new state-driven /driver screen (WI-5) reactively renders the ride view from the active-order store once accept updates it. The test still vi.mock's react-router useNavigate and asserts the spy has 0 calls, so a regression that re-adds navigation is caught. ALL branch decisions route through the pure offerActionOutcome(kind, phase) from WI-1 via a single applyDecision(kind, current) helper that sets phase + all three banner flags (showOffline/showStale/showReasonError) + the dismiss (dismissAfterMs===0 -> onDismiss now; >0 -> setTimeout; null -> stay) in one place — no manual pre-reset preamble. TRAP HANDLED: accept returns 'noop' on the double-tap guard, which is NOT a member of OfferActionKind (success|stale|offline|noReason); handleAccept guards `if (outcome.type === 'noop') return` before applyDecision so tsc narrows the union (decline's outcome union IS exactly OfferActionKind, no guard needed). Stale renders its role='alert' banner at top level driven by showStale AND sets nextPhase='expired'; the expired countdown message is gated on `phase==='expired' && !showStale` so pure expiry shows 'Nabídka vypršela' while stale shows 'Nabídka již není dostupná' — never both. Decline no-reason: `if (!selectedReason) { applyDecision('noReason', phase); return }` BEFORE calling decline, so decline() has 0 calls when no reason picked (test 5) while still routing through offerActionOutcome; DeclineReasons.onSelect clears showReasonError. Double-tap: the useOfferAccept/useOfferDecline hooks own isPending (unchanged); OfferCard disables the buttons while pending (test asserts the 'Přijímám...' button is disabled). a11y: Accept is theme.touchTargets.primary (64px), Decline theme.touchTargets.min (48px), both real <button>s; every string via t(); axe clean via the shared '../../../shared/test/axe' helper. ZERO new i18n keys — all consumed keys (driver.offer.boxLabel/distanceEta/pickup/dropoff/accept/decline/accepting/declining/staleOffer/offlineHint/expired/declineReason*/priceCzk) already landed in WI-1; NO locale JSON touched. SCOPE respected: only OfferCard.tsx + OfferCard.test.tsx created; OfferTakeover.tsx left untouched (WI-5 removes it and swaps DriverLayout to <OfferCard/>); no DriverMapInner/RideSheet/DriverMapScreen/router/DriverLayout/locale edits. Test-harness note for reviewers: CountdownRing is stubbed in OfferCard.test.tsx (its real 500ms setInterval caused userEvent hangs); the stub renders '30' and exposes onExpired for the expiry test. The stale-dismiss and expiry tests use FAKE timers with fireEvent + `await act(async () => fireEvent.click(...))` (the async act flushes the awaited accept() microtask so the banner paints) then `act(() => vi.advanceTimersByTime(2000))` — NOT userEvent.setup({advanceTimers}) which coupled to the clock and hung. A file-level `afterEach(() => vi.useRealTimers())` guard prevents a leaked fake clock (from a timed-out test) hanging the next real-timer test (the root cause of the intermediate cascade). Per web-testing.md#timers-and-async (fake timers, no real sleeps). NOTE: because CountdownRing is stubbed here, the 'countdown has an accessible label' a11y AC is not exercised in this suite — CountdownRing is reused-unchanged and separately tested.
